sentence: This project builds mathematical representations of the spatial architecture of molecular and cellular systems and studies their evolutionary properties.
This project studies how changes in a skin gene are linked to atopic dermatitis in Latino patients.
This project tries to find out how stretch in the heart's upper chambers leads to abnormal heart rhythms.
This project provides lipoproteins, apolipoproteins and other protein samples and reagents that other projects in the program depend on.
This project studies how groups of brain cells in the circadian clock network pass signals on to control daily rhythms in behavior.
This project studies how missing tumor suppressor genes change how pancreatic cancer responds to treatments that block an oncogenic gene and to immune therapies.
This project develops scan methods that combine CT with radiotracer imaging to measure cancer more accurately while keeping radiation dose low.
This project studies how short RNA pieces in the blood of people with lupus affect the immune system.
This project uses gene screens in human heart cells to find genes and compounds that affect heart damage from doxorubicin.
This project tries to find out how B cells evolve to make stronger antibodies against infections.
This project develops correction methods so that oxygen level and body temperature devices measure more accurately in patients with different skin tones.
This project builds tools that collect evidence on complementary medicine from published papers and link it with conventional medicine.
This project tries to improve gene drive in the mosquito Aedes aegypti and to switch it off when it is not wanted.
This project builds label-free optical microscopy tools that show molecular and functional features of biological processes.
This project tests which parts of aging in mice, and ways to slow it, still hold outside the lab in more natural settings.
This project tries to find better ways to detect elder abuse among older Veterans by improving screening and using medical record data.
This project uses wearable sensors to measure how young people use e-cigarettes in real time.
This project applies unsupervised learning methods to dietary intake data to find patterns of eating linked to coronary heart disease.
